Our Services

Everything Your Outdoor Space Needs

From sprinkler start-ups to full landscape makeovers — we handle it all for homes and businesses.

🌱

Sprinkler Start-Up

Get your system ready for the season. We inspect, test, and fine-tune every zone for full coverage and peak efficiency.

💧

New Installation

Custom-designed sprinkler systems built from scratch, planned zone by zone to deliver water exactly where it's needed.

🔧

Upgrades & Expansions

Expanding your lawn or upgrading to a smart controller? We modernize and grow your existing irrigation system seamlessly.

❄️

Blow Out (Winterization)

Our compressed-air blow-out clears all water from your lines before the freeze, protecting your system all winter long.

🌳

Landscape Design

Beautiful outdoor spaces tailored to your vision — plant selection, lawn layout, and design that boosts your curb appeal.

🍂

Lawn Care & Clean-Up

Ongoing lawn maintenance and seasonal spring/fall clean-ups so your property always looks its very best.

Locally Rooted, Genuinely Caring

Gilgal Landscape and Irrigation is a Calgary-based business built on honest work and real relationships. We bring the same care and attention to every job — whether it's a small residential start-up or a large commercial installation.
